fields.title: actions/setup-go
fields.licence: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BlueOak-1.0.0 AND ISC AND 0BSD

sections.What we use it for:
The `lint` job in `kac.yml` is the one job that runs it. The step passes `go-version: stable`, which installs the newest stable Go on the day. The next step runs `go install` with the actionlint version the job pins.

`stable` is a moving version. [std-CI] allows one in a job with `contents: read`, and `lint` declares nothing wider.
The action's `token` input defaults to the job's `github.token`.

Every step pins the action to the commit behind `v7.0.0`, and Dependabot moves the pin. `versions` approves the major the pin sits in.
sections.Licence and obligations:
The repository and its `package.json` declare MIT. The action runs bundled code under `dist/`, and the `.licenses/` folder at the pinned commit records each npm dependency in it. Most are MIT. The others are these:

| Licence       | Packages                                           |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Apache-2.0    | `@protobuf-ts/runtime`, `@protobuf-ts/runtime-rpc` |
| BlueOak-1.0.0 | one version of `minimatch`                         |
| ISC           | the other version of `minimatch`, `semver`         |
| 0BSD          | `tslib`                                            |

The four entries marked `other` are `@actions/http-client`, `balanced-match`, `brace-expansion` and `concat-map`. Each licence file is the MIT text.

The runner fetches the action for each job, and nothing here redistributes it, so nothing follows for anything this repository publishes.
sections.Where it is used: Nowhere in this catalogue. It runs in the `lint` job of `kac.yml`, and no service ships what it installs.
